tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background in every screen. Body copy never sits on it without a surface unless it is ink or ink-muted (both pass AA on bg).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the day's hero block. ink and ink-muted are checked on it.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, hovered rows, anything that sits above a surface. Also the ground for inputs and tooltips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and table dividers only. Never the only signal of a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) and other meaningful 1px edges: at least 3:1 against bg, surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and raised. Titles, numbers, body copy.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and raised: labels, units, metadata, explanations.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg, surface and raised: timestamps, axis labels, disabled labels. Still AA.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand signal: links, active nav, focus ring, primary fill, selected state. As text it reads on bg, surface, raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, selected pill). Never on the page.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text and for the active nav item. accent on accent-soft passes AA in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Readiness VERDE and positive deltas. Text on bg, surface, raised and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success text and the VERDE readiness block.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Readiness AMARILLO and cautionary deltas. Text on bg, surface, raised and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text and the AMARILLO readiness block.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Readiness ROJO, destructive actions and errors. Text on bg, surface, raised and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text, the ROJO readiness block and destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information and sync notices. Text on bg, surface, raised and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind info text and informational banners.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Condensed, scoreboard DNA. Numbers are always tabular.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per screen: the readiness score or the session's tonnage. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and section names in the page header.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family, three steps, no invented sizes.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles and section headings inside a screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy, labels, buttons, list rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels, units, timestamps, axis text.

spacing.note: 4px base; the only gaps and paddings the interface uses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control, between label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of the same card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen top padding, between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop section breaks and empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: Soft but not pill-shaped; only status dots and avatars use full.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, hero cards, the session summary.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, the rest timer ring.

shadow.note: Two elevations. Focus is a ring, not a glow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, anything floating above the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the page colour then 2px of accent. Applied with :focus-visible, never removed.
